renderer: voice/psy_synth.py (RBJ resonant-lowpass kick/bass/acid-lead, sidechain duck, convolution reverb, ping-pong delay, bus comp + true-peak-aware limiter)

kick_oneshot_check.note: the kick one-shot in isolation, before mixing with hats/lead/noise which dilute the mix-level fraction below

method_notes.kick: sine, pitch env 150->50Hz tau=14ms, amp env tau=90ms, + differentiated-noise click transient
method_notes.bass: saw one octave below corpus pitch, RBJ resonant lowpass (Q=2.2) w/ decaying cutoff envelope, sidechain duck ~82% dip / ~90ms recovery per kick, tanh saturation
method_notes.acid_lead: saw one octave above corpus pitch (v0 corpus has one pitched channel only, see module docstring), RBJ resonant lowpass (Q=7.5), accent on beat-1/4 steps, portamento slide on legato (no-rest) note pairs, tanh drive, ping-pong tempo-synced delay
method_notes.atmosphere: slow-LFO filtered noise bed + per-phrase (16-bar) filtered noise riser
method_notes.reverb: convolution with a synthesised bandpassed-noise impulse response (no sampled IRs)
method_notes.master: 28Hz highpass, RMS envelope-follower bus compression (thresh -9dB linear 0.35, ratio 3:1), 4x-oversampled true-peak-aware gain + soft-knee limiter (identity below 0.85*ceiling, asymptotic to -0.5dBFS ceiling above it)
